newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens against dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens against dollar, pound.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr was marginally weaker against the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.
It posted the birr at a mean rate of 6.4730 against the dollar compared to 6.4510 last week.
Against the pound, the birr was posted at a mean rate of 10.8260 from 10.8021; at 0.055372 against the yen from 0.055212 last week; and 4.0410 against the mark from 4.0592 last week.
